question: The anthem, logo, and mascot for the 2025 Khelo India Para Games were unveiled in the presence of Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya. What is the mascot for the Khelo India Para Games 2025 named?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Ujjwala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The anthem, logo, and mascot for 2025 Khelo India Para Games were unveiled in the presence of Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Khelo India Para Games 2025** will take place in **New Delhi** from **March 20 to March 27**.
 
• The **anthem** of the event is "**Khelega khelega mera India, jeetega jeetega mera India**" to inspire athletes and fans.
 
• The mascot is named **Ujjwala**, inspired by the **house sparrow**, symbolizing **perseverance and resilience**.
 
• **1,300 athletes** will compete in six disciplines: **para-archery, para-athletics, para-badminton, para-powerlifting, para-shooting, and para-table tennis**.
 
• The competition will be hosted across **three venues**: **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**, **Indira Gandhi Stadium**, and the **Dr Karni Singh shooting range**.
